name: mcharbor-plugin-swarm-frontend
description: UMD bundle for the McHarbor Docker Swarm plugin.
_versions: Every range here is the host's own (src/frontend/package.json), and has to stay that way. The plugin resolves its own copy of each of these — that is what the aliases in vite-plugin.config.ts are for — but it compiles host source reached through @resources against them. React Table is the one that bites: the host's shared table-features.ts is written to the v9 API, so an ^8 pin here fails the build with a wall of MISSING_EXPORT rather than a version complaint.
